rows.text: At its meeting on 29 October 2013, the Monetary Council reviewed the latest economic and financial developments and voted to reduce the central bank base rate by 20 basis points from 3.60% to 3.40%, with effect from 30 October 2013.

At its meeting on 29 October 2013, the Monetary Council reviewed the latest economic and financial developments and voted to reduce the central bank base rate by 20 basis points from 3.60% to 3.40%, with effect from 30 October 2013.
